description: Searches every font family fontpool can install, deduplicated, with the category, providers and use-case tags for each. Filter by category or tag to get a shortlist worth choosing between; exclude: ['google'] narrows to the families Google Fonts does not carry, and hasAxis: 'wdth' to variable fonts with a width axis. Call with no arguments to see the category counts, tag vocabulary and axis vocabulary. Use font_properties for the full description of one family.

exclude.description: Drop families these providers carry. ['google'] leaves the 218 families Google's API does not carry.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the family name.

hasAxis.description: Only families carrying this variable axis, e.g. 'wdth' (width), 'opsz' (optical size), 'slnt' (slant), or an expressive one like 'CASL'. Call with no arguments to list the axis vocabulary.

limit.description: Maximum families to return. Defaults to 100.

provider.description: Restrict to one provider. Omit for all.

tag.description: Use-case tag, e.g. 'editorial', 'branding', 'legible', 'code'. Call with no arguments to list the vocabulary.

variableOnly.description: Only families with a variable axis.

name: list_fonts
title: Search available font families
